project.name: Auth Service
project.description: Owns the internal authentication service and its versioned HTTP APIs.

issues.summary: Remove Auth API v1 on October 1
issues.content:
Issue: AUTH-900
Summary: Remove Auth API v1 on October 1
Type: Change
Status: Done
Assignee: Asha Rao
Reporter: Neel Shah
Labels: breaking-change, api, removal

Description:
On 2026-10-01 Auth Service removed Auth API v1 and POST /v1/auth from production. Auth API v2 at POST /v2/auth is the supported contract. The removal was completed after the readiness review stated that every known consumer had migrated.
